params.place: on the map: all of India seen from above, the sea round its coast

moments.what: India's paper sheet brightens over the dimmed world
waves roll in against the whole coast
a bright blue line races along the coast from Gujarat
the line reaches West Bengal and the camera pushes onto the south
a big question mark stamps in the Bay of Bengal

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: भारत का समुद्र तट अचानक इतना लंबा कैसे हो गया?

params.place: on the map: the coastal states round the peninsula, a lighthouse on the tip at Kanyakumari

moments.what: every coastal state flashes pale blue at once
a lighthouse rises at India's southern tip with the count on its board
the camera pulls back and the coast line pulses white
the lighthouse beam sweeps the sea
a magnifying glass slides onto the coast of Gujarat

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: 9 स्टेट समुद्र से लगे हैं। पर इनकी लकीर में छिपा राज़ क्या है?

params.place: on the map: the west coast along the Arabian Sea, Gujarat down to Keralam

moments.what: Gujarat paints in and its coast lights blue, a boat sails off it
Maharashtra paints in, its coast lights
Goa paints in, its tiny coast lights
the camera slides down the coast as Karnataka paints in
Keralam paints in, its coast lights to the tip

params.place: on the map: the east coast along the Bay of Bengal, Tamil Nadu up to West Bengal

moments.what: Tamil Nadu paints in round the tip, its coast lights
Andhra Pradesh paints in, its coast lights
the camera rises up the coast as Odisha paints in
West Bengal paints in, its short coast lights at the delta

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: फिर तमिलनाडु, आंध्र प्रदेश, ओडिशा और पश्चिम बंगाल।

params.place: on the map: all of India wide, out to the islands in both seas

moments.what: Daman and Diu light teal on Gujarat's coast
Puducherry lights teal on the east coast
Lakshadweep's islands light in the Arabian Sea with a ring
the camera pans east as the Andaman and Nicobar islands light
every island's coast traces bright

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: साथ में दमन दीव, पुडुचेरी, लक्षद्वीप और अंडमान निकोबार के द्वीप।

params.place: on the map: Gujarat's coast, the Gulf of Kutch and the Gulf of Khambhat

moments.what: the coastal states dim and Gujarat glows
Gujarat lifts off the sheet
its coast traces round the two gulfs
the camera pushes in on Gujarat
a buoy sign bobs up in the sea with Gujarat's length

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: स्टेट्स में सबसे लंबा तट गुजरात का, पूरे 2,340.62 km।

params.place: on the map: all of India as an old school atlas page, the coast drawn with a ruler

moments.what: the map turns to old yellowed paper
the camera pulls back to all of India
a straight-ruled line draws along the coast from Gujarat
the ruled line rounds the southern tip
an old atlas sign drops in with the old length
the ruled line's corner dots flash
the sign shakes
a question mark pops over the Arabian Sea

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: पर पहले पूरे भारत का तट गिना जाता था बस 7,516.6 km। फिर इतना बढ़ा कैसे?

place: on the map: the Gulf of Khambhat close up on a detailed map, its bays and bends
on the map: all of India with its islands, the new coastline glowing

moments.what: the old ruled line holds still over Gujarat's coast
a measuring wheel starts rolling along the shore and the map turns from old paper to today
the map sharpens as the camera dives toward the Gulf of Khambhat
the detailed coast line runs in and out of the bay
the small bends of the shore flash white one after another
the camera pulls back and the islands' coasts light up in both seas
rings pulse round Lakshadweep and the Andamans
the whole new coastline blazes white
the atlas sign drops in with the new length

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: ज़मीन नहीं बढ़ी, नाप बदली। अब बड़े मैप पर हर खाड़ी और मोड़ नापा गया, छोटे द्वीप भी जोड़े गए, और तट हो गया 11,098.81 km।

params.place: on the map: the southern tip close up between the two seas, then the west and east coasts, then back to all of India

moments.what: the camera pans to the west coast and its states lift with waves lapping them
the camera pans across to the east coast and its states lift
the camera pulls back to the peninsula, both coasts glowing
a west-or-east pair of arrows points at both coasts
a comment bubble pops over the Bay of Bengal
the colours fade back and the camera returns to the hook's India
